sentences.text: Holdemania filiformis is a gut bacterium that has been isolated and grown in culture.
A screen of over 3000 bacterial isolates reported that Holdemania filiformis produces the neurosteroid isopregnanolone, and two of its enzymes were characterised after expression in Escherichia coli.
A study of patients with ulcerative colitis on a low-FODMAP diet reported increased presence of Holdemania.
A Mendelian randomisation analysis reported Holdemania inversely associated with the risk of atrial fibrillation.
